setupPick.title: Which servers should Daminus watch?
setupPick.subtitle: From {file} · {entries}, {left}. Login is tested as soon as a host is ticked.
setupPick.subtitleNoneLeft: From {file} · {entries}. Login is tested as soon as a host is ticked.

filter.label: Filter hosts by alias or address

tip.not_checked: ssh refuses ~/.ssh/config, so this host is not tested yet. Fix the line in the banner, then check again.
tip.queued: Waits for a free slot (Hosts at once).
tip.connecting: Handshake, up to the {n} s connect timeout.
tip.agent_wait: The SSH agent asks you to approve. Not counted in the timeout.
tip.testing: Logged in, reading system, user and permissions.
tip.host_key_unknown: The host key is not trusted yet. Nothing is written to known_hosts.
tip.host_key_changed: Stops this host. The key differs from the one on record.
tip.key_rejected: Auth failed. The ssh-add fix is in the card below.
tip.unreachable: DNS, no route or refused. Check the address or VPN.
tip.timed_out: No answer in {n} s. Retry, or raise it in Settings › Scan.
tip.untested: Tick this host to test its login.

fail.key_rejected: The key in your config is not loaded in ssh-agent. Add it, then retry. Your other hosts keep going.
fail.key_rejected_nokey: The keys ssh offered were not accepted. Check that the right key is loaded in ssh-agent, then retry. Your other hosts keep going.

unreachable.dns: The address did not resolve. Check the address or VPN.
unreachable.refused: Nothing listens on port {port}. Check Port in ~/.ssh/config.
unreachable.no_route: There is no route to the server. Check the address or VPN.
unreachable.other: DNS, no route or refused. Check the address or VPN.

fail.timed_out: No answer in {n} s. Retry, or raise it in Settings › Scan.
fail.host_key_unknown: This server's host key is not trusted yet. Compare the fingerprint with the one you expect, then run the line below once and accept it. Daminus never writes known_hosts.
fail.host_key_changed: The host key differs from the one on record, so this host is stopped. Find out why before you connect to it.

perm.missing: No permissions missing | 1 permission missing | {n} permissions missing
perm.noGroups: not in docker, adm or systemd-journal

docker.ok_group: Answers · {user} is in the docker group
docker.no_permission: No permission · add {user} to the docker group

logs.no_permission: No permission · not in adm or systemd-journal, so log checks will say Needs permission

folder.denied: Not readable · {user} cannot list it, so disk and upload checks skip it
folder.missing: Missing · moved or a typo in the path

leftOutRow.title: Left out {n}
leftOutRow.note: Wildcards set defaults, so they are read but never listed.

footer.hint: A ticked host that failed stays in and retries on the first scan.
footer.none: Tick a host that logs in to go on.

rail.title: What the test runs
rail.note: One read-only script, about 1 s per host. BatchMode means it never waits for a password.

error.title: Could not read your SSH config
